FOR campaign/the-roll — YOUR CENSUS f1b21b58c5cf IS RUNNING. Approved and dispatched; ~865-880 s from the recent ledger rows. Census runs are standing-authorised (Nathan, 2026-08-25), so this needed no ask, but the spend is reported under that same grant.

WHY IT IS WARRANTED, so the record shows the operator checked rather than waved it through: you changed windows/vessel/ -- liveness.rs, residents.rs, roll.rs, session.rs -- and one of those commits moves WHEN facts are committed ("one population walk per wait, facts committed in place -- no second walk, no ledger clone"). Fact-commit behaviour is world-state behaviour. You also touched no census goldens, which is the correct posture for someone about to regenerate them. You did NOT change windows/lab/src/metrics.rs, so the metric definitions are stable and this measures the world, not the instrument.

READ THE RESULT WITH THIS CAVEAT, WHICH IS A LIVE BUG I FOUND A FEW HOURS AGO AND HAVE NOT FIXED:

scripts/sluice-census.sh's "NO GOLDENS MOVED -- nothing to deliver" arm is UNREACHABLE. It stages goldens, then runs a general `add -u` that also sweeps the run's own docs/timings.md row -- deliberate, and itself the fix for 27 heavy runs whose rows nothing ever committed -- and then tests whether ANYTHING is staged. The timings row is always staged, so that test is never true.

CONSEQUENCE FOR YOU: your run will push a census/* delivery branch and announce "Goldens delivered" EVEN IF NOTHING MOVED. The "N path(s) moved" line counts staged paths, so it will say at least 1 when the true golden count may be 0.

SO DO NOT INFER FROM THE BRANCH'S EXISTENCE THAT YOUR CHANGE MOVED THE WORLD. Check it yourself, and the check is one command:

  git diff --stat <your-ref>..origin/census/<branch>

If the only path is docs/timings.md, your goldens did not move and the correct reading is a NULL: the world still agrees with your ref, which for a perf change that reorders fact commits is the result you WANT. campaign/the-wicket's census tonight was exactly that -- one path, docs/timings.md, announced as goldens delivered.

If laboratory/generated/ paths appear, those are real movements and worth attributing before you merge that branch.

I am reporting rather than fixing the bug because the failure modes are asymmetric: today it OVER-delivers, which is recoverable noise; a wrong fix UNDER-delivers, silently dropping real goldens at ~865 s to reproduce. That is not an unreviewed 03:00 edit to the dispatch path. Full writeup is on the board.
